text:
Iko Mba Ụwa FIFA nke 2006 ka e mere na Germany site na 9 June ruo 9 July, bụ mbipụta mbụ nke Germany jikọtara ọnụ nabatara. Leipzig ghọrọ obodo mbụ nke East Germany mbụ nabatara egwuregwu Iko Mba Ụwa, otu n’ime ọtụtụ ihe mbụ nyere asọmpi ahụ ọnọdụ ya n’akụkọ ihe mere eme nke asọmpi ahụ. Ndị otu iri atọ na abụọ ka e kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke anọ, ebe ndị abụọ kacha elu site na otu ọ bụla na-aga n’ọkwa knockout nke otu onye na-ewepụ onye ọzọ nke gụnyere round nke 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu ọnọdụ nke atọ na ikpeazụ. Mba asatọ mere mpụta mbụ ha na Iko Mba Ụwa, gụnyere Ghana, Ivory Coast, Togo, Angola, Ukraine, Czech Republic, Trinidad and Tobago, na Serbia and Montenegro. N’ụzọ dabara adaba maka asọmpi nke ndị nche nchebe mepere ma mechie, Philipp Lahm mepere asọmpi ahụ ma Marco Materazzi ga-emecha nweta ihe nhatanha ya dị mkpa, oge mbụ ma mbụ na ikpeazụ nke ihe mgbaru nke Iko Mba Ụwa si na ndị nche nchebe pụta.

Ikpeazụ ahụ gbakọtara Italy na France na Olympiastadion nke Berlin. Zinedine Zidane, onye meriri Golden Ball dị ka onye ọkpụkpụ kacha mma nke asọmpi ahụ, mepere ihe mgbaru site na penalty nke nkeji 7, na-eji Panenka kụọ n’elu crossbar ma banye. Materazzi weghaara ihe nhatanha na nkeji 19, na-eji isi ya tinye n’ime nkuku Andrea Pirlo. Egwuregwu ahụ kwụsịrị 1–1 mgbe oge mgbakwunye gasịrị, mana ihe onyinyo na-adịgide adịgide bịara n’oge ikpeazụ: e zipụrụ Zidane maka ịkụ Materazzi n’obi, bụ ihe ikpeazụ nke ọrụ egwuregwu ya.

Asọmpi ahụ gara na penalties, ebe Italy meriri 5–3. David Trezeguet nke France bụ naanị onye ọkpụkpụ tụfuru, kick ya kụrụ crossbar, tupu Fabio Grosso tinye ihe mmeri iji nye Italy aha Iko Mba Ụwa nke anọ. France bụ ndị nke abụọ, ebe Germany ndị nnabata wepụtara ọnọdụ nke atọ, na-emeri Portugal 3–1 na egwuregwu mgbakwunye. Miroslav Klose nke Germany nwetara Golden Boot na ihe mgbaru ise, ọnụ ọgụgụ kacha nta iji chịkọta chaatị ihe mgbaru kemgbe 1962. Asọmpi ahụ hụkwara ọnụ ọgụgụ ndekọ nke kaadị yellow na red e nyere. Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bịara ruru ihe dị ka 3,359,439 n’ofe egwuregwu 64, na-eme nkezi ihe dị ka 52,491 kwa egwuregwu.
